args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on the run day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

When a weekly scheduled export is created on the day it is due (e.g. Monday), its initial next_run_at is computed as one week in the future rather than the current day, causing the first weekly export to be skipped. Fix the scheduler logic so that a newly created weekly schedule sets next_run_at to the current or upcoming occurrence correctly.
